How I work

Understand. Prototype in code. Verify.

“A clickable prototype is more honest than a picture: it shows what the system can do and where it fails.”

01

Understand before I draw

What data really exists, who looks at it, in which situation?

Example 19 real hosts, real IP zones, one real attack test case.
02

Prototype in code

Instead of static mockups I build interfaces in HTML, CSS and SVG, with real states.

Example TONAL: waveform and CMYK separations computed from the actual pixels.
03

Verify and write it down

Every case study ends with decisions, one iteration and what is still missing.

Example RELAIS: the “RUN/STOP/MRES” label overflowed the module; fixed by removing, not shrinking.
About me

One profession, two halves: design and implementation.

First communication design (diploma, Düsseldorf, grade 1.4) and agency years in interface and web design, then web development, because handing designs over stopped being enough. Today I design and build interfaces myself.

Most recently fullstack developer at TA Bildungszentrum GmbH (PHP, Symfony, Twig). My own OT/IT lab provides the domain depth behind IronGrid, RELAIS and the Security Monitor.

Away from the screen: an ultrasonic radar on Arduino with gate drivers and MOSFET half-bridges, Rust on Codeforces, and as much snow as possible.
